issues.detail: A/B testing tool running: Endless Testing. Check the test plan against the readiness verdict: with too few conversions a test cannot reach a result, and without analytics there is nothing to read it against

access_requests: Cloudflare: an API token with Account Analytics Read (or a Web Analytics viewer seat)
Google Search Console: restricted user, to see search queries and landing pages
Conversion count for the last 3 months (orders, leads or form submissions from the inbox or CRM), so the test readiness baseline is CONFIRMED rather than ASSUMED
